title.label: Love the app, but the event time selector is a nightmare

content.label:
The Structured app has garnered considerable admiration for its aesthetic design and overall utility. However, there exists a particular feature that has proven to be quite frustrating: the process of setting start and end times for events.

The time selector, it appears, is unnecessarily complicated and lacks user-friendliness. A minor error can result in a tedious correction process that may take anywhere from 20 to 30 minutes. Moreover, adjusting the start time often inadvertently alters the end time, creating a cumbersome cycle of adjustments that can be exasperating.

Additionally, the options for jumping ahead by+1 and +2 hours seem to introduce more confusion than clarity. It would be beneficial for the Structured team to consider simplifying the time selection process. Despite the app's many strengths, enhancing this particular feature could significantly improve user experience, allowing individuals to manage their schedules more efficiently. After all, time is a precious resource, and users should not have to expend excessive effort merely to organize it.

Structuring my day has never been easier.

Structured takes the chaos of a full schedule and turns it into something that feels calm, clear, and completely manageable. The app strikes the perfect balance between functionality and elegance. It doesn’t just look good—it feels good to use. Every detail, from the subtle haptics to the colour choices and smooth animations, is clearly built to mirror Apple’s design aesthetic. It feels like something Apple could’ve made themselves—seamless, intuitive, and genuinely native.

The timeline-based layout is a game changer. Unlike traditional calendar or to-do apps, Structured gives your day a clear flow, which makes staying on track almost effortless. The interface is so well thought out that it practically encourages productivity without ever feeling overwhelming.

From quick task creation with natural language to its satisfying checkmarks and widgets that keep you grounded throughout the day, Structured nails every touchpoint. Syncing across devices works flawlessly, and with support for Siri and Shortcuts, it integrates beautifully into my daily routine.

If you’ve been struggling to manage your time, or just want an app that genuinely helps you enjoy planning, Structured is a must-have. It’s not just another productivity app—it’s the app I now rely on to give shape to my day.
